character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Create a pixelated chibi-style character of an Asian woman around 35 years old. She has a cute, friendly, and charming appearance, with expressive eyes and soft facial features. She is wearing a uniform with horizontal green and white stripes, and green jeans. Use a retro pixel-art aesthetic, with crisp pixels, a limited color palette, clean outlines, and adorable proportions. Full-body character, centered composition, simple background, highly detailed pixel art.
